description: Switzerland is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Transport demand > Switzerland", published or maintained by are.admin.ch (publisher inferred from the link). Summary data is available in English and other languages: You can also apply for the raw data, which is similar in scope to the German MiD. This if free for researchers (maybe only Swiss researchers). Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Transport demand" lists it under "Switzerland". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport demand inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
